Reserved native BLE/mesh acceptance — trial @TRIAL@

Generation performs no device operation. Every case starts not_run. This extends
1903's identity, host-permission and reserved peripheral procedures; that GATT
procedure does not establish L2CAP, mesh TLS, gateway leases, profiles or power.
Use the exact generated commands, candidate hashes and identity records. Save
stdout, stderr, exit status and monotonic start/end time separately in fresh
private files. A CLI success or a visible neighbour is not packet proof.

1. Qualify the topology before changing anything.
   Use only the reserved Mac/account/profile and three named devices in inventory.
   Compare native Mac serial/OS/account/controller/permission records, CLI hash,
   Linux serial/device UUID/tenant/OS/kernel/Agent executable hash, USB/controller
   address/firmware and native C5 PSRAM board/firmware hash with the signed-off
   inventory. Match direct wired/USB management selectors independently using
   console identity; never infer a physical device from a reused IP or hci index.
   Record `btmgmt --index N info` and `btmon` startup adapter information on the
   selected Linux console, plus `uname -a`, `/etc/os-release`, and `ip -j addr`.
   No SSH, remote shell, pairing reset, bond deletion, driver reload or reflash is
   part of these commands. Bring any missing observation through the reserved
   serial/local console, or retain its case pending.

   Borrower A: original Realtek USB 13d3:3549 class, with exact firmware/feature and
   prior observed 0x0c LE Connection Update refusal captured in the qualification
   record. Donor B: independent lab uplink, qualified coded PHY; Lite C: qualified
   native operator-router C5 PSRAM, matching coded PHY support. Mac M has no other
   enabled Wendy router/profile in this account. All live links, power settings
   and affected controllers must be owner-reserved: power applies device-wide.
   Require all three saved participation states disabled and normal/default radio
   settings before starting. Compare every saved carrier/roam/share flag with the
   baseline record; generator includes exact restore commands for those flags.
   Keep independent management while disabling mesh Ethernet/Wi-Fi. The borrower
   management subnet must have no independent Internet route. Only B has the
   owner-controlled upstream route to the exact HTTPS body challenge. Record
   route tables, interface names/MACs, DNS and physical cable/attenuator positions.

   Copy the pinned traffic CA to the exact borrower-console path recorded in the
   plan and verify its SHA256 before curl. Do not use curl -k. The traffic URL,
   expected body hash and upstream server request log are independently owned.
   Prepare owner-operated recovery for all changed settings and any C5 profile
   restart before the first change. Do not perform this on a working shared mesh.

2. 2527 — a real rejected controller request keeps its ACL and CoC.
   Turn Lite C off for this case; enable the generated BLE-only A/B configurations.
   Start the bounded 180-second btmon captures on A and B before admitting links.
   Compare live handle, role, peer address, adapter identity and LE feature pages
   with the qualification record. Require an actual LE Connection Update command
   on A and its Command Status 0x0c (Command Disallowed), not merely an Agent log.
   On that SAME ACL/CoC, require subsequent TLS handshake/authenticated mesh link,
   matching endpoint principals, and three fresh management RPCs to A through B separated by
   10 seconds. Use direct `*-topology` and the exact discovered `*-mesh-info`
   commands from M after its operator-connect. The qualified layout must give M
   only B as an entry router and A's selected next hop must be B; a direct M→A
   connection cannot satisfy A↔B traffic. Capture route/link IDs and byte
   counters before/after. Verify no replacement ACL/CoC or hidden LAN/Wi-Fi path
   explains the success; correlate btmon and Agent journal timestamps/handles.
   Stop after 120 seconds. If firmware accepts the request, never emits it, or
   reconnects to a new ACL before success, this refusal case is inconclusive.
   Unknown HCI results/timeouts must not be relabelled a successful refusal.
   The automated eight-outcome fixture covers software decisions; it cannot
   create a controller-specific physical result.

3. 2524 — a slow physical BLE gateway lease completes across controller steps.
   Use the qualified owner-operated attenuator/shielded layout in the slow-link
   record, including model, manual setting, peer placement and prior latency
   capture; no invented rig API or unqualified interference injection is allowed.
   A remains BLE-only with roam enabled, B shares its independent upstream; C is
   off. Start captures and fresh journals before A joins. On the borrower console
   record `ss -tnp`, `ip -j route`, `ip -6 -j route` and current DNS before/after.
   Require one actual TCP connection to B's mesh ULA port 18867, with TLS handshake
   bytes progressing for more than 15 seconds and less than 60 seconds. Correlate
   the same four-tuple/ACL, successive offline/negotiating controller observations,
   and absence of a borrowed default/resolver before its lease is granted. Then
   require roaming, an installed Internet tunnel/default and actual exact HTTPS
   body bytes through B, plus the upstream server's request nonce/time. Resolve
   the challenge hostname through the donor and retain the DNS response. Repeat
   the challenge after at least 35 seconds to span real heartbeat exchanges.
   Withdraw B's sharing using its generated donor-no-sharing command; require A removes the borrowed default/tunnel and the
   challenge fails. Restore B's generated BLE-only configuration, requalify the
   slow interval, and require a fresh successful lease and body challenge.
   A transfer shorter than 15s, a new connection every step, a direct uplink, or
   status without real HTTPS/DNS data does not pass this case. If the qualified
   rig cannot produce the required interval, retain physical acceptance pending.

4. 2576 — native carrier selection and listener ownership.
   Restore the unattenuated layout. Connect A/B on their isolated owner-reserved
   Ethernet segment, then execute both generated lan-and-ble commands while BLE
   traffic is active. Observe actual overlapping inbound/outbound native TLS
   attempts at both peers, their principals, listener address/port, selected
   connection cost, and application/RPC outcomes. Require one selected forwarding
   path and bounded standby/losing-stream retirement without retiring the live
   peer. Do not require all backups to close: current compatible peers can retain
   a slower backup. Send 20 fresh exact management requests over 60 seconds while
   physically removing only the reserved Ethernet link, then restoring it.
   Require recovery over BLE and return to the faster path, with no duplicate
   application delivery, connection-slot leak or listener loss. Record whether an
   application stream was interrupted; ordinary recovery is not an uninterrupted
   stream guarantee. Verify the listener's live owner PID/executable and socket
   before/after each change. Then disable A participation, require all its owned
   mesh listener/attachment lifetimes stop, and re-enable A to obtain fresh TLS
   traffic. Never kill an arbitrary listener or bind a competing host port.
   Repeat the handover with B and actual native Lite C, not just two Linux
   nodes. Use the already configured owner-reserved AP in native_ap_record
   (exact BSSID, band/channel and isolated Ethernet segment reaching B). Do not
   modify saved Wi-Fi credentials. Enable C BLE-only, then lite-wifi-and-ble;
   require native C5 TCP/TLS and BLE attachments with B and actual crossed
   attempts in B's journal plus C's pinned-firmware serial trace. Query C through
   its mesh selector, turn only C's mesh Wi-Fi carrier off with lite-wifi-off,
   require fresh RPCs over BLE, then re-enable Wi-Fi and require recovery to the
   faster carrier. On B require the same live listener owner and no leaked
   connection slots. C has firmware tasks/connection handles, not Linux PIDs:
   use its actual serial/topology observations. Missing native firmware telemetry
   leaves the corresponding ownership assertion pending; Linux-only traffic
   cannot close native Lite acceptance. Keep C USB management throughout.
   Exact listener bind-failure/cancellation and selection controls are software
   fixtures; physical crossed attempts must actually be observed for this case.

5. 2669 — native Mac discovery, selected organization and broker restart.
   Use the reserved Mac's real CoreBluetooth permission, not a mocked scan. With
   B/C in the qualified native topology and no direct Mac LAN mesh route, run
   operator-connect, bounded operator-discovery, operator-topology, and a fresh
   mesh-info for each expected reachable endpoint. Require actual BLE carrier
   admission, matching selected tenant/operator principal and verified destination
   identity. Retain public issuer fingerprints; never copy private keys/tokens.
   Do not manually nominate a router or restore an obsolete saved-router recipe.
   Run operator-disconnect. Confirm old broker PID/birth exits and topology shows
   disconnected; passive discovery must not silently rejoin. Run connect again
   and require a new broker PID/birth, same saved operator identity, native
   discovery and fresh RPC success. Independently compare the reserved profile's
   selected organization; a working stale cached issuer from another organization
   must not substitute for that selection. Software issuer controls cover the
   adversarial mismatch; hardware output alone cannot assert all negative trust
   cases. Repeat once with only C5 PSRAM as entry router. C6 is not an entry router.

6. 2603 — profile/tuning serialization and truthful power evidence.
   Turn A off. Keep B/C independent wired/USB management and matched coded-PHY
   qualification. Record normal/default status, controller feature support and
   all owned ACL handles. On C select coded-s2, allowing its declared restart;
   on B run donor-coded-s2 while C is reconnecting. Repeat at most 10 times with
   normal↔coded-s2 and normal↔coded-s8; use both peers' generated mode commands.
   Preserve start/completion times and raw btmon. At least one observation MUST
   show a new link's tuning overlapping B's profile-change interval; runs with
   only sequential idle updates cannot establish race acceptance. Require the
   completed saved policy and actual PHY readback agree for each surviving
   handle, no stale coded tuning after completed normal mode, and fresh exact
   mesh RPC traffic after each transition. Unsupported/refused/unknown readbacks
   must remain truthful; requested S2/S8 coding is not proof of observed coding.
   The controlled-response unit tests establish the precise admission-lock order;
   this physical scenario establishes actual BlueZ/controller behavior only for
   its observed overlapping trace and exact firmware.
   Apply the explicitly approved numeric donor power command once. Compare
   requested settings, HCI/MGMT completion and actual supported per-handle power
   readbacks. A kernel/controller refusal is a supported refusal outcome, not
   proof of physical transmit power. Do not choose maximum implicitly. Restore
   default power and normal mode on B/C, including any required C5 restart, and
   require fresh exact RPC traffic and default/unknown status as appropriate.

7. Original-failure sensitivity and restoration.
   Software controls are concrete: 2527 removes only rejection fallback; 2524
   withdraws the live pending lease; 2603 existing controlled-IO barriers restore
   the stale-policy/admission ordering; 2576/2669 existing transport and issuer
   controls retain their own exact assertions. Do not substitute their success
   for hardware execution. A historical full binary may have incompatible mesh
   protocols or persistence. Run a historical physical control only with an
   independently reviewed isolated build/overlay, unchanged trust/protocol and
   an owner-qualified recovery procedure. Without those prerequisites, record
   physical fail-before sensitivity pending rather than install a guessed build.
   Before any timeout, lost management or unsafe RF/power observation, stop the
   trial and use independent management to restore. Disconnect only the reserved
   Mac profile; on A/B/C run off, normal, power-default, then restore-net. Compare
   all saved settings and participation with the recorded baseline, confirm
   leases/tunnels/default routes and owned captures ended, and verify direct
   management still works. Retain saved identities/bonds/certificates and logs;
   do not delete profile directories, re-enroll or clean unrelated resources.
   Mark a case passed only with its exact provenance, stimulus, runtime evidence
   and completed restoration. Every missing/unobservable condition remains
   not_run or inconclusive, never an inferred pass.
